SELECT c.frst_nm, c.last_nm, SUM(p.amt) AS total_amt FROM cust c JOIN pymt p ON c.cust_id = p.ref1 GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.frst_nm, c.last_nm ORDER BY total_amt DESC, c.frst_nm ASC, c.last_nm ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT c.frst_nm, c.last_nm, COALESCE(SUM(p.amt),0) AS amount FROM cust c LEFT JOIN pymt p ON c.cust_id = p.ref1 GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.frst_nm, c.last_nm ORDER BY amount DESC, c.frst_nm ASC, c.last_nm ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT c.frst_nm, c.last_nm, SUM(p.amt) AS total_amt
FROM cust c

LIMIT 10

SELECT a.frst_nm AS `名`, a.last_nm AS `姓`, COUNT(*) AS `获奖数`
FROM actr a
JOIN awd w ON a.actr_id = w.ref1
GROUP BY a.actr_id, a.frst_nm, a.last_nm
ORDER BY `获奖数` DESC, a.frst_nm ASC, a.last_nm ASC
LIMIT 3

SELECT c.frst_nm AS `名`, c.last_nm AS `姓`, COUNT(DISTINCT k.card_id) AS `卡数`

SELECT c.cty
FROM cust cu
JOIN addr a ON cu.ref2 = a.addr_id
JOIN city c ON a.ref1 = c.cty_id
WHERE cu.cust_id = (
  SELECT p.ref1
  FROM pymt p
  GROUP BY p.ref1
  ORDER BY SUM(p.amt) DESC
  LIMIT 1
)

SELECT c.cty
FROM cust cu
JOIN addr a ON a.addr_id = cu.ref2
JOIN city c ON c.cty_id = a.ref1
WHERE cu.cust_id = (
  SELECT p.ref1
  FROM pymt p
  GROUP BY p.ref1
  ORDER BY SUM(p.amt) DESC
  LIMIT 1
)

SELECT city.cty FROM pymt JOIN card ON pymt.ref1 = card.card_id JOIN cust ON card.ref1 = cust.cust_id JOIN addr ON cust.ref2 = addr.addr_id JOIN city ON addr.ref1 = city.cty_id GROUP BY cust.cust_id, city.cty ORDER BY SUM(pymt.amt) DESC LIMIT 1
